description: A span of work by one actor, named by the kernel from its admission event and replaceable only by that actor. Every field is optional; the actor is the actor of record on the admission.

claims: the actor of record on this resource's admission opened a span of work at the recorded position on the chain, with the recorded harness and purpose when present

the key recorded as the actor signed this request over its canonical bytes, and the authority it cited resolved, link by link, to a root on this same chain — both re-derivable offline from the bundle alone
doesNotClaim: on whose behalf the work ran beyond the authority the admission cited — an Endorsement says a key may admit these Kinds in this term, never that any particular person asked for this session
that this session's events are all of its events

that any person, office, or organization holds the key that signed — the record binds the act to a key and the key to the authority it acted under, and neither to anyone; a reader who wants a name pins a root key and owns the pin
